issue.title: Seed does not appear to be changed on rerolls in conversation mode

coreClaim: Conversation rerolls send a fresh LLM seed instead of reusing a fixed custom seed from the merged generation parameters.

reproduction.method: Request-path proof from startGeneration regeneration parameters.
reproduction.evidence: Before reroll seed normalization, a regenerate turn reused the same fixed customParameters.seed carried in merged LLM parameters.

verification.originalReproEvidence: Passed: 10 tests. The new regression captures a conversation regenerate stream request and proves customParameters.seed changes from 4294967295 to a fresh seed; the adjacent non-regenerate guard preserves fixed seeds.
verification.baselineEvidence: Passed: line endings, architecture, frontend typecheck, Rust check, docs, discovery, launcher safety, and unused-code check.

preflight.evidence: gh PR search for #2243 and reroll/seed keywords found only older adjacent reroll PRs; local branch/worktree search found no issue-2243 branch or worktree; issue assigned to @me.

dependencies.evidence: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile completed in the clean issue worktree and did not change dependency declarations.

edgeCases: Regenerate path replaces a fixed customParameters.seed and preserves sibling custom parameters.
Non-regenerate path preserves fixed customParameters.seed for users who intentionally want deterministic first-pass generations.
Claude subscription runtime metadata is still appended after seed normalization.

finalDoneGate.notes: Focused request-path proof, typecheck, proof gate, and pnpm check passed locally. PR remains pending commit, push, draft creation, CI, Bunny after push, and CodeRabbit.
